src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: 2022 plan: P.L. 2022, ch. 5 and ch. 6 (2022-S 2162 Sub A / H 7323 Sub A), effective Feb. 16, 2022; 2 districts
R.I. Gen. Laws 17-4-2 (history: P.L. 2022, ch. 5, sec. 5 and ch. 6, sec. 5, effective Feb. 16, 2022)

The 2022 act keeps the same whole towns in each district; only the line through Providence changes. Census areas: District 1 falls from 695.5 to 693.8 sq km and District 2 rises by the same amount between the cb_2020 and cb_2022 files, then stays the same in cb_2024.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2022 plan: P.L. 2022, ch. 5 and ch. 6 (effective Feb. 16, 2022); 38 Senate districts
R.I. Gen. Laws 22-1-2 (history: P.L. 2022, ch. 5, sec. 2 and ch. 6, sec. 2, effective Feb. 16, 2022)

First effective for elections on or after Sept. 1, 2022. Census cb_2022 sldu file: LSY 2022; 34 of 38 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent (up to 36 percent); equals the 2024 file.
